ONE uniform 3-column by 2-row grid, six equal square cells, landscape canvas aspect 3:2. No visible grid lines. Each full pet occupies at most the middle 58 percent of its cell, with ample transparent space on all sides. Consistent scale, colors, anatomy, camera, and base position across cells. prompts.starfall: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent RPG companion aura overlay, square canvas.
